name: Railways (RRB / RRC) — Apply
instructions: RRB account (name, DOB, parents' names, email and mobile codes), then the CEN application. RRB steps with Aadhaar or DigiLocker verification are done here: you give the number, consent and OTP in chat. Fills from your profile first (no AI for known questions), asks you only for codes (OTP), passwords, captchas and anything new, pauses for your review, then submits. For Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification it asks you for the number, consent and OTP/PIN in chat and types them in (never saved). Payments are always done by you.

starterActionPlan.description: Register or sign in: fills your details, asks for OTP, password and captcha
Fill every page of the application (details, education, photo, signature, declaration)
